subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: What canonical user principal and authorization model should OpenClaw use for per-user token and cost reports across channels, agents, and provider usage surfaces?
rationale: The implementation cannot be safely chosen from code alone because the request affects privacy, billing/quota semantics, cross-channel identity, and who may view another user's usage.

options.title: Design core accounting contract
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved principal and authorization contract to the gateway/session usage model, then build the Dashboard and command views on that contract.

options.title: Expose plugin/export seam first
options.body: If billing belongs outside core, add only the minimal privacy-safe plugin or export API needed for external accounting systems.

options.title: Decline per-user views
options.body: Keep OpenClaw's built-in usage views scoped to session, agent, channel, provider, model, and date when per-user reporting is outside the product boundary.

recommendation.title: Design core accounting contract
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved principal and authorization contract to the gateway/session usage model, then build the Dashboard and command views on that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the only strong history signal on the current usage API, gateway aggregation, UI usage surface, and related docs.
